name: Gabe Ugliano
excerpt: Gabe Ugliano, nicknamed 'Smelly Gabe' by Percy, is Percy's unpleasant stepfather.
notes: Gabe Ugliano is Percy's stepfather, known for his unpleasant demeanor and smell. He manages the Electronics Mega-Mart in Queens but spends most of his time at home playing poker and drinking beer. He expects Percy to provide him with gambling funds and threatens him to keep it a secret from Sally. Gabe is described as looking like a tuskless walrus and is generally disliked by Percy.
